title: TechSpark Hackathon 2026
description: A 24-hour inter-college hackathon focused on AI, IoT, and FinTech. Teams of 2–4 students compete for prizes worth ₹1,00,000.

title: Web Dev Workshop
description: Hands-on session covering HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript ES6+. Certificates provided to all participants.

title: Annual Cultural Fest – Rang 2026
description: Music, dance, drama, and art competitions. Participation from 30+ colleges across Maharashtra.

title: Career Fair 2026
description: Meet 50+ top recruiters from tech and finance companies. Dress code: formal. Bring 5 copies of your resume.

title: Sports Day 2026
description: Track and field, cricket, football, and badminton tournaments. Inter-department competition with medals for top 3.

title: Machine Learning Bootcamp
description: 3-day intensive bootcamp on ML fundamentals, scikit-learn, and neural networks using Python. Laptop required.

title: Photography Contest
description: Theme: 'Campus Life'. Submit up to 5 photos. Top 3 winners get certificates and cash prizes.

title: Cybersecurity Seminar
description: Industry experts discuss ethical hacking, penetration testing, and data privacy law. CTF challenge included.

title: Debate Competition
description: Motion: 'AI will replace human creativity.' Teams of 2 debate for and against. English and Hindi rounds.

title: React.js Workshop
description: Build a full React app from scratch. Covers hooks, context API, and React Router. Prerequisites: HTML, CSS, JS.

title: Alumni Meet 2026
description: Connect with alumni from top companies. Panel discussions on career paths, entrepreneurship, and industry trends.

title: Data Science Hackathon
description: Analyse real-world datasets and present insights. Tools: Python, Pandas, Matplotlib. Teams of 3.

title: Yoga and Wellness Day
description: Guided yoga session, mindfulness talk, and healthy diet workshop. Open to staff and students.

title: Open Mic Night
description: Perform your original music, poetry, or stand-up comedy. Slots of 5 minutes each. Register to perform or just attend.

title: Entrepreneurship Summit
description: Startup pitches, investor meet, and talks by successful founders. Pitch your idea for seed funding of up to ₹50,000.

title: UI/UX Design Sprint
description: Two-day design sprint using Figma. Learn user research, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing.

title: Chess Tournament
description: Swiss-format tournament with 7 rounds. Open to all students. Top 8 advance to knockout stage. Rating certificates issued.

title: Cloud Computing Workshop
description: Hands-on AWS & Azure basics. Deploy a web app to the cloud. AWS free-tier account required. Certificates provided.
